title: ADA Harness Configuration
description: Project-specific configuration for the ADA Harness. This is the only file you edit to point the harness at a new application.

//.description: Free-text comment. Ignored by the harness.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the running application under test. Overridable via the ADA_BASE_URL environment variable.

browser.description: Browser engine used for the axe-core / accessibility-snapshot scan.

settleTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for hydration/network idle before scanning a page. Overridable via ADA_SETTLE_MS.

appSrcDir.description: Application source root (relative to this file) that auto-fixes are applied to.

reportDir.description: Directory (relative to this file) where every generated artifact is written.

wcagTags.description: WCAG / best-practice tags passed to axe-core's withTags().

login.description: Scripted login for simple username/password forms with known selectors.

navigation.description: Multi-page navigation strategy for the specialized engines.

mode.description: "reload" calls page.goto() for every route (default, works for any app). "spa" uses history.pushState navigation after the first page (opt-in, requires a real client-side router).

widgets.description: Selectors used by the Widget Behavior Engine.

accordionSelector.description: Playwright locator selector for accordion/disclosure headers.

auth.description: Optional interactive session capture (npm run save-auth) for apps needing a real login (SSO/ADFS/OAuth/etc.) before scanning.

readySelector.description: CSS selector that only exists once login has succeeded. Leave empty to confirm via a terminal prompt instead.

autoFix.description: Project-layout assumptions for the auto-fix engine.

sourceExtensions.description: File extensions (with leading dot) eligible for automatic source fixes.

htmlEntryPoints.description: Candidate paths (relative to the application root) for the <html lang> fix, tried in order.

applyFixes.description: When false (default), npm run auto-fix never edits source — every fix is reported only, same as unsafe rules. Set true to let it write the small set of unambiguous, additive fixes directly to source. Alternatively, leave this false and run 'npm run auto-fix:apply' (adds --apply) for a one-off apply without editing config.json.
